title: Yoga Classes
shortDescription: Weekly yoga and pranayama practice open to all levels.
description:
Open to everyone, the temple’s yoga classes combine asana practice with pranayama: the yogic science of breath control, one of the eight limbs of Raja Yoga described in Patanjali’s Yoga Sutras. Regular pranayama practice is associated with a steadier mind, reduced stress, and greater physical well-being alongside the postures themselves.

Classes meet every Wednesday from 6:30 to 7:30 PM at the temple. No experience is necessary. Just come ready to breathe and move.

title: Dance Classes
shortDescription: Kalagangothri: classical Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi instruction for students of all ages.
description:
Kalagangothri is the temple’s classical dance program, teaching Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi in one-hour weekly sessions that combine dance technique, music knowledge, and the theory behind each art form.

Classes are taught by Guru Akhila Chetan, Ms. Gauri, and Guru Chetan H, and meet Saturdays at 2:00 PM at the temple (schedule changes are announced by email in advance).

Registration is $50 (non-refundable), with season tuition of $300 for a 3-month season plus a $15 per-season temple donation, due at the start of each season.

title: Summer Camp
shortDescription: A five-day camp introducing children to spiritual practice, scripture, and yoga through activities and stories.
description:
The temple’s summer camp gives children a five-day introduction to spiritual foundations through age-appropriate activities, chanting, and stories drawn from Hindu scripture. The temple believes that a grounding in spiritual values helps children build emotional resilience, empathy, and stronger family bonds alongside their academic growth.

Highlights
Vedic chanting, including Dasha Shanti mantras and the Guruparampara Stotram
Recitation of Maitreem Bhajata and world peace prayers
Stories and lessons on friendship and values drawn from the Bhagavad Gita
Surya Namaskara and yoga asanas
Seats are limited each season
